relationships.subject: ACE inhibitor
relationships.evidence_quote: Angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors (ACEi) are the leading cause of drug-induced angioedema in the USA

relationships.subject: fresh frozen plasma
relationships.evidence_quote: FFP contains kininase II, which breaks down accumulated bradykinin.

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: bradykinin-mediated angioedema is either medication-induced, such as due to ACEi (figure 7) or from deficiencies of C1 inhibitors

key_findings: Case of late-onset ACEi (lisinopril) bradykinin-mediated angioedema presenting as small bowel obstruction plus airway angioedema.
Fresh frozen plasma, supplying kininase II, resolved symptoms when icatibant, ecallantide and C1-INH were unavailable.
